//: Config-freeze lock (GOL-1735 / GOL-1406-D). A repo-level hard stop on config drift.
//frozen: When true, the `Config freeze` required check FAILS any PR that touches a path in `paths`, overriding normal Tier-0 human approval. Use during incidents, deploy windows, or market-season stability freezes to stop ALL config change, then flip back to false.
//lift: Flipping this file is itself a protected-path change (protected-paths-guard), so engaging or lifting a freeze needs an allowlisted human's SHA-bound approval. This file is intentionally NOT in `paths` so a freeze can always be lifted.
//reason: Human-readable reason shown in the failing check while frozen.
